title: ODDPOLY1322876: polynomial odd-token ranks and balanced growing stream

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE ODDPOLY1322876 algorithm and configuration fully specified in proof.md and odd_partition.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^32768; otherwise public growing k equal to n if odd and n+1 otherwise, the explicit polynomial token-rank circuit with fully counted reversible history, integer-root balanced geometry, bounded READY/PENDING controller, finite source/demand/identity caps, measured tree and physical odd/two-adic full-secret decoders) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal coset copies. Jointly on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, discarded copies and aborts, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((330719/250000)*sqrt(n)-n^(49/100))) with an absolute outside constant. Every allocated wire, circuit generation/history, lookup, reset and bit-address cost is counted. The negative term is literal and all input-dependent costs are proved uniform, not hidden as fixed constants. The chosen envelope has exact growth index1/2. All mathematical premises are reproduced in the two evidence files; no prior verdict or artifact-identity assertion is a premise.
